data.title: Garamendi advocates for rail safety bill
data.description: Congressman John Garamendi, a senior member of the House Transportation & Infrastructure Committee and Co-lead of the Railway Safety Act, held a press conference alongside labor leaders and other congresmembers to commemorate the East Palestine Disaster on its third anniversary and call for the passage of what they called common sense rail safety measures. On Feb. 3, 2023, 50 cars of a 150-car train derailed near the Pennsylvania-Ohio border. data.title: Spain: Commuter train hits crane in wake of 2 deadly crashes
data.description: Emergency crews are responding to a train crash in southeastern Spain after it hit a construction crane. The incident has added to growing scrutiny of rail safety after two serious accidents this week.
